system.name: ThinKV
system.one_liner: A thought-adaptive KV cache compression framework for reasoning models that assigns precision by thought importance and progressively evicts tokens of less critical thoughts.

content.variant_note: five sibling token-eviction grids (four prior method groups and ThinKV) followed by an accuracy versus latency scatter plot
content.argues: Prior eviction methods decide per token and lose accuracy or speed; ThinKV types tokens by thought type and lands in the accurate, fast corner of the plot.
content.subject: Toy token grids showing which cached tokens each KV cache compression method keeps or evicts while decoding, and a scatter of accuracy against time per output token.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw every compared method on one identical grid (rows = generation steps) with a snapshot row beneath, so the eye sees only the eviction pattern change; end with a latency-accuracy scatter whose green 'Accurate' and 'Fast' arrows mark the corner where the proposed method sits.
lessons.suits: Comparisons of token-level policies (eviction, sparsification, masking) over a generation or sequence axis, where a toy grid per method makes the policy difference visible.

evidence: Illustrative comparison of KV cache compression methods as tokens are generated
Most, however, focus on the prefill phase of long-input tasks (Li et al., 2024) (Figure 1(a))
ThinKV achieves near-lossless accuracy with under 5% of the original KV cache

summary: ThinKV compresses the KV cache of large reasoning models by typing each generated token with the kind of thought it belongs to (reasoning, execution, transition), giving tokens precision by thought importance and evicting those of less critical thoughts. Panel (a) draws the same triangular token grid, one row per generated token, for four groups of existing methods (SnapKV and RocketKV, H2O and RaaS, LazyEviction, R-KV): blue cells are cached, green is the current token, crossed grey cells are evicted, with callouts for the LazyEviction window and R-KV's redundant tokens. Panel (b) redraws the grid for ThinKV with R, E and T letters and group quantization. Panel (c) is a scatter of LiveCodeBench accuracy against time per output token with green 'Accurate' and 'Fast' arrows, ThinKV a star at the upper left.
summary_zh: ThinKV 按思维类型（推理、执行、过渡）压缩推理模型的 KV 缓存。(a) 用同一三角形词元网格画四类现有方法的驱逐模式，(b) 是带 R/E/T 字母的 ThinKV，(c) 是准确率对每词元耗时的散点图，星标在左上最优角。
notes: Prior kind kept (side-by-side-contrast, design-family); the scatter is a result plot inside the contrast rather than a separate kind. The two placed bitmaps in the digest are taken to be the green gradient arrows. Meaning of hatched and pale-orange cells in the snapshot row of (b) is not given by the caption or the paragraphs. Refresh Period and Group Quantization are described from their labels only.
